name: chdig
description: Interactive TUI for exploring and monitoring ClickHouse databases with real-time queries, merges, mutations, and system statistics

chdig.description: Comprehensive TUI interface for ClickHouse database administration and monitoring with real-time insights
chdig.usage:
chdig queries # Show running queries
chdig --url clickhouse://localhost:8123 slow-queries # Monitor slow queries
chdig --host localhost --user admin merges # Show merges
chdig --cluster production replicas # Check replicas status
